status: research-only source binding; excluded from portable implementation handoff
public_call_order: for each executed request, date.localized-day-ordinal once in scalar context and once in list context
error_protocol: Neither documented facade exposes a public error observer for Date_DaySuffix. Warnings, stdout, exceptions, and process stderr are captured without inventing an error value.
return_fidelity: Defined empty text, undefined values, text, one-element list returns, and absence of a return after exception are distinct. The configuration return is also preserved: DM6 success returns defined empty text while DM5 success returns undef.
isolation: Each observation attempt loads and configures one backend/language in a fresh process and fresh temporary working directory. Calls never cross profiles or languages.

binding_only_feature.reason: Omitted/undef/reference/extra Perl argument shapes, warnings, and scalar/list calling contexts are source-binding behavior.
